Subject: Need help with a tenancy eviction case

Hello, my name is Leena Iyer. I am a 35-year-old general physician living in Hubballi. I have a tenancy problem with Anjali Patil involving Rs. 65,000 in rent, and the landlord is trying to evict the tenant after a rent increase was refused. My case number is R.C.S. No. 2463/2020 in the Hubballi District Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 81087 08291 or email leena.iyer@example.com.
